paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between vocabulary size and scaled ratio for input and embedding complexity. The x-axis is labeled “Vocab Size” and has a linear scale ranging from 5000 to 40000, with tick marks every 5000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Scaled Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks every 0.2 units. A blue line, labeled “Input Complexity”, is composed of connected circular markers; it begins at approximately (5000, 1.0) and decreases to approximately (40000, 0.0), exhibiting a steady decline with data points at (10000, 0.8), (15000, 0.6), (20000, 0.4), (25000, 0.3), (30000, 0.2), and (35000, 0.1). A cyan line, labeled “Embedding Complexity”, is composed of connected circular markers; it begins at approximately (5000, 0.0) and increases to approximately (40000, 0.8), exhibiting a steady increase with data points at (10000, 0.2), (15000, 0.4), (20000, 0.6), (25000, 0.7), (30000, 0.75), and (35000, 0.8).
